product_decision.graph_surface: offline Teacher lesson neighborhood inside Learn

what_is_now_functional: the Teacher Learn map supports local node search
the Teacher Learn map supports relation-type filtering
clicking a node updates a selected model panel and links to the model drawer
clicking an edge updates a selected relation panel and links to the relation drawer
graph controls render without provider calls, embeddings, runtime hooks, or external libraries
what_remains_missing: archive case picker integration for Learn
strongest_useful_signal: The graph now supports exploration of the lesson neighborhood while keeping the learning path and model/relation drawers as the source of user-facing meaning.
strongest_unresolved_risk: This remains a server-rendered graph workbench. The same interaction model needs to be ported to the compiled Observatory source before it becomes the single long-term UI path.
